He was away from the car for five minutes as he picked up a prescription for his four-year-old daughter. When he returned, there was a boot lock on his wheel, put there by the owner of one of the storefronts due to them parking in his store's lot. The elderly gentleman explained, showing that they had not been there for a long time and had just picked up a prescription. The police got involved, and a $40 charge was the issue to get the lock removed. In this case, the owner of the boot and the restaurant was also from Libya and a recent immigrant, just like the family. I found it all a little disturbing.

It was not me personally involved; I was more of a viewer from the outside. It's all over the news here locally, not a good image unfortunately.
